quests.title: No Line on the Road
quests.summary: Take Bernie's birthday cake from Derry~Londonderry over the border to her sister Áine in Donegal Town, and see how an open border works.

steps.text: Head west out of Derry~Londonderry and say hello to the walker on the border road in Glenveagh.
Carry on south and give the cake to Áine in Donegal Town.
Take Áine's card back to Bernie at the west end of Derry~Londonderry.

quests.reward: Three soda farls, and standing in Northern Ireland and Ireland.
